answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: staked work-history. An identity's weight grows only from original texts a rotating jury grades; new accounts start near zero. Forging N agents means paying for N distinct jury-passing answers each epoch, and near-duplicate checks against the kernel of accepted texts reject reskins; at a summit of established peers one proven collision strips standing. Attack cost stays linear in fakes while returns are sublinear - the economics of fake identity collapse like basalt.
